speaker: Doctor
text: I need to understand the severity of your symptoms. On a scale of 1 to 10, how would you rate your abdominal pain, and when did the vomiting start? Also, have you noticed any changes in your urine output or stool color?

speaker: Patient
text: 44-year-old female. The patient presents to the emergency department with confusion that started this morning. The patient's husband reports that she initially complained of abdominal pain, diarrhea, and fatigue after eating and has vomited 3 times. The patient has progressively become more confused throughout the day. The patient's past medical history includes morbid obesity, diabetes, hypertension, dyslipidemia, a sleeve gastrectomy 1 month ago, and depression with multiple suicide attempts.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details; given your recent sleeve gastrectomy, are you currently taking any new supplements or medications like metformin? I also need to know if you have noticed any fruity odor to your breath or deep, rapid breathing. REQUEST TEST: Serum_Electrolytes, Glucose, Ketones, Liver_Function_Tests, Ammonia.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA) secondary to missed post-bariatric diabetes management
